toxic.introQuote: "Is my relationship toxic... or am I overreacting?"
toxic.introDesc: If this question keeps coming back, it's never by chance. A toxic relationship is not defined by arguments, but by repeated dynamics that generate fear, guilt, loss of self-esteem, or emotional confusion.
toxic.disclaimer: This test is neither a medical diagnosis nor a judgment.
toxic.disclaimerDesc: It's a lucid self-assessment tool to understand what you're really experiencing.
toxic.testInfo: 25 questions • About 5 minutes • Anonymous and free
toxic.reminderText: This test is purely indicative. It is by no means an exact and precise result, and should not be used to replace professional advice. If you believe your relationship is truly toxic or even dangerous, contact real specialists.
